types.title: Light Commercial & Panel Vans

faq.q: Which driving licence do I need to rent a commercial vehicle?
faq.a: Panel vans and pickups with a maximum permitted weight of up to 3,500 kg can be driven on a category B licence. Heavier truck-class vehicles require a C1 licence or higher; confirm the licence category for your vehicle with our team before booking.

faq.q: Can I rent in my company's name and get an invoice?
faq.a: Yes. Corporate rentals are invoiced to your company; just share your tax office and tax number when booking.

faq.q: Can I rent several commercial vehicles at once?
faq.a: Yes. Our fleet has several units of the same model, so group rentals for crews are possible. Tell us how many vehicles you need and for which dates, and we will check availability and get back to you.

faq.q: How much is a monthly commercial vehicle rental?
faq.a: Each vehicle's daily and monthly list price (excluding VAT) is shown on its detail page. A monthly rental costs less than renting the same vehicle at the daily rate.

commercial.ctaTitle: Need several vehicles for your crew?
commercial.ctaText: Tell us how many vehicles, which dates and where they will be used; we will check availability and get back to you quickly.

faq.a: It depends on the vehicle, but the monthly list price is clearly lower than renting the same vehicle for 30 days at the daily rate. Each vehicle's daily and monthly prices are shown side by side on its detail page.

faq.q: Is there a mileage limit on monthly rentals?
faq.a: The mileage limit and excess charge are stated clearly in the rental contract. Tell us your expected monthly mileage before booking and we will work out the right option together.
